podcast.title: Became The Temptations
podcast.body: The Primes later went on to become the iconic Motown group, The Temptations. "The Primes, who would later go on to be the Temptations"

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 111: "Heat Wave" by Martha and the Vandellas

podcast.title: Geographical Origins
podcast.body: The Primes were a trio who originated in Birmingham, Alabama, before relocating to Cleveland, and subsequently settling in Detroit, where their music career developed. "a trio who had grown up in Birmingham, Alabama and then had moved to Cleveland before moving in turn to Detroit."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 116: "Where Did Our Love Go?" by The Supremes

podcast.title: Milton Jenkins' Vision for Female Backing Singers
podcast.body: The Primes' manager, Milton Jenkins, sought to enhance their act after being inspired by Ray Charles's backing vocalists, The Ray Lettes, leading him to consider forming a female backing group for his male vocalists. "their manager Milton Jenkins was inspired by Rachel's backing vocalists, The Ray Lettes."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Talent Contest Rivals
podcast.body: The Primes developed a rivalry with The Delphiys (Martha Reeves' group) and The Primettes (who became The Supremes) in amateur night talent contests. "The Primes, who would later go on to be the Temptations and the Primette, who would name themselves after the Primes, but later became the Supremes."
